metadata.intro: Welcome to the Fluid Dynamics and Nonlinear Systems gateway. This roadmap connects the foundational principles of continuous media to the mathematical complexities of turbulence and chaos.

pillars.title: 1. Ideal Fluids & Conservation Laws
pillars.narrative: The foundational kinematics and dynamics of continuous media in the absence of dissipation or internal friction.

pillars.title: 2. Viscous Flow & Hydrodynamics
pillars.narrative: The introduction of internal friction, sheer stress, and the mathematical complexities of boundary layers.

pillars.title: 3. Chaos, Turbulence & Nonlinearity
pillars.narrative: The breakdown of predictability, energy cascades, and the statistical mechanics of highly complex, non-linear systems.

pillars.title: 4. Astrophysical & High-Energy Fluids
pillars.narrative: The behavior of compressible gases and plasmas acting under extreme gravitational and electromagnetic fields across the cosmos.
